rows: Decode a pprof profile's function table

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Decode a pprof profile's function table: one row per function with `function_id` (verbatim), `name`, `system_name` (mangled), `filename`, and `start_line`. Join `function_id` from pprof.locations.lines to symbolize raw locations. `src` may be a path, glob, list, or `BLOB`; a bad file yields one error row.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the functions defined in a profile.","sql":"SELECT function_id, name, filename, start_line FROM pprof.main.functions('data/go_cpu.pb.gz') WHERE error IS NULL ORDER BY function_id;"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"function_id","type":"UBIGINT","description":"The function's unique id within the profile (verbatim); referenced by pprof.locations.lines[].function_id."},{"name":"name","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Human-readable function name, or NULL if unset."},{"name":"system_name","type":"VARCHAR","description":"System/mangled function name (e.g. the C++ mangled symbol), or NULL if unset."},{"name":"filename","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Source file that contains the function, or NULL if unset."},{"name":"start_line","type":"BIGINT","description":"First source line of the function (0 if unknown)."},{"name":"file","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Source path the row came from (NULL when the profile was passed as inline BLOB bytes)."},{"name":"error","type":"VARCHAR","description":"NULL on success; otherwise this is an error row for a file that could not be read or decoded, with every data column NULL and the failure message here."}]

Decode a pprof profile's location table

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Decode a pprof profile's location table: one row per location with `location_id` (verbatim), `address`, `mapping_id`, and `lines` (a `LIST(STRUCT(function_id, line))`, innermost inlined frame first). Join `mapping_id` to pprof.mappings and `lines[].function_id` to pprof.functions to symbolize. `src` may be a path, glob, list, or `BLOB`; a bad file yields one error row.
rows.vgi.doc_md: pprof locations: `location_id`, `address`, `mapping_id`, and `lines` (`STRUCT(function_id, line)[]`). Join `mapping_id` to `mappings`, `lines[].function_id` to `functions`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Locations with their line table (inlined frames).","sql":"SELECT location_id, address, mapping_id, lines FROM pprof.main.locations('data/go_cpu.pb.gz') WHERE error IS NULL ORDER BY location_id;"}]

Decode a pprof profile's mapping table (build_id feeds vgi-symbols)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Decode a pprof profile's mapping table: one row per loaded binary/library with `mapping_id` (verbatim), the loaded address range (`memory_start`, `memory_limit`), `file_offset`, `filename`, and `build_id`. The `build_id` is emitted verbatim so the addresses of unsymbolized native frames flow to a symbolizer (vgi-symbols) for addr→symbol resolution. `src` may be a path, glob, list, or `BLOB`; a bad file yields one error row.
rows.vgi.doc_md: pprof mappings: `mapping_id`, `memory_start`, `memory_limit`, `file_offset`, `filename`, `build_id`. `build_id` feeds a downstream symbolizer.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the mappings that carry a build_id (the binaries still to symbolize), from a native profile passed inline as BLOB bytes.","sql":"SELECT mapping_id, filename, build_id FROM pprof.main.mappings(from_base64('')) WHERE error IS NULL AND build_id IS NOT NULL;"}]

Decode a pprof profile's metadata (sample types, period, duration)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Decode a pprof profile's metadata into one row: `sample_types` (a `LIST(STRUCT(type, unit))` describing each value slot), `period`, `period_type` (a `STRUCT(type, unit)`), `duration_nanos`, `time_nanos`, and `default_sample_type`. Use `sample_types` to interpret the `value` list in pprof.stacks / pprof.samples (the Nth type names value[N]). `src` may be a path, glob, list, or `BLOB`; a bad file yields one error row.
rows.vgi.doc_md: pprof profile metadata (one row): `sample_types` (`STRUCT(type, unit)[]`), `period`, `period_type` (`STRUCT(type, unit)`), `duration_nanos`, `time_nanos`, `default_sample_type`. `sample_types` names the `value` slots.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Inspect a heap profile's sample value types and duration, from a profile passed inline as BLOB bytes.","sql":"SELECT sample_types, period, duration_nanos, default_sample_type FROM pprof.main.meta(from_base64('')) WHERE error IS NULL;"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"sample_types","type":"STRUCT(type VARCHAR, unit VARCHAR)[]","description":"The value types each sample carries, in order; the Nth entry names value[N] in pprof.stacks / pprof.samples."},{"name":"period","type":"BIGINT","description":"Number of events between sampled occurrences (the sampling period)."},{"name":"period_type","type":"STRUCT(type VARCHAR, unit VARCHAR)","description":"The kind of event the period counts (e.g. (cpu, nanoseconds)); NULL if unset."},{"name":"duration_nanos","type":"BIGINT","description":"Wall-clock duration the profile covers, in nanoseconds (0 if not meaningful)."},{"name":"time_nanos","type":"BIGINT","description":"Collection time as nanoseconds since the Unix epoch (0 if unset)."},{"name":"default_sample_type","type":"VARCHAR","description":"The preferred sample value type's name; NULL if unset."},{"name":"file","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Source path the row came from (NULL when the profile was passed as inline BLOB bytes)."},{"name":"error","type":"VARCHAR","description":"NULL on success; otherwise this is an error row for a file that could not be read or decoded, with every data column NULL and the failure message here."}]
rows.vgi.title: Profile Metadata

Decode a pprof profile's raw samples (location ids + values + labels)

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Decode a pprof profile's raw samples: one row per sample with `location_ids` (a `LIST(UBIGINT)`, leaf first), `value` (a `LIST(BIGINT)` aligned to meta.sample_types), and `labels` (a `MAP`). No resolution is applied — join `location_ids` to pprof.locations and onward to pprof.functions, or use pprof.stacks for the pre-resolved view. `src` may be a path, glob, list, or `BLOB`; a bad file yields one error row.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Raw pprof samples: `sample_id`, `location_ids` (`UBIGINT[]`, leaf first), `value` (`BIGINT[]`), and `labels` (a `MAP`). Join `location_ids` to `locations`, or use `stacks` for resolved frames.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Raw samples with their leaf location id.","sql":"SELECT sample_id, location_ids[1] AS leaf_loc, value FROM pprof.main.samples('data/go_cpu.pb.gz') WHERE error IS NULL;"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"sample_id","type":"BIGINT","description":"1-based index of the sample within its profile; joins to pprof.stacks.sample_id."},{"name":"location_ids","type":"UBIGINT[]","description":"The sample's location ids, leaf first; each joins to pprof.locations.location_id."},{"name":"value","type":"BIGINT[]","description":"The sample's measured values, one BIGINT per meta.sample_types entry, in order."},{"name":"labels","type":"MAP(VARCHAR, VARCHAR)","description":"Sample labels; duplicate keys are de-duplicated (first wins)."},{"name":"file","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Source path the row came from (NULL when the profile was passed as inline BLOB bytes)."},{"name":"error","type":"VARCHAR","description":"NULL on success; otherwise this is an error row for a file that could not be read or decoded, with every data column NULL and the failure message here."}]
rows.vgi.title: Raw Samples

rows: SELECT sample_id, location_ids[1] AS leaf_loc, value FROM pprof.main.samples('data/go_cpu.pb.gz') WHERE error IS NULL;
Flatten a pprof profile into flamegraph-ready stack rows

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Flatten a pprof profile into one row per sample with the call stack pre-resolved: `value` is a `LIST(BIGINT)` aligned to meta.sample_types, `labels` is a `MAP(VARCHAR, VARCHAR)`, and `frame` is a `LIST(STRUCT(function, filename, line, address))` ordered leaf-first (inlined frames expanded, unsymbolized frames keep their address). This is the 90% view: a flamegraph diff across many profiles is a GROUP BY frame … SUM(value) with no manual location/function join. `src` may be a file path, a glob, a list of paths, or inline `BLOB` bytes; a bad file yields one error row.
rows.vgi.doc_md: Flatten a pprof profile into flamegraph-ready rows: `sample_id`, `value` (a `LIST(BIGINT)` aligned to the sample types), `labels` (a `MAP`), and `frame` (a `LIST(STRUCT(function, filename, line, address))`, leaf first). Use it to diff profiles in SQL.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"Flatten a profile passed inline as BLOB bytes (self-contained): each sample's leaf frame and per-type values.","sql":"SELECT sample_id, frame[1].function AS leaf, value FROM pprof.main.stacks(from_base64('')) WHERE error IS NULL;"},{"description":"Top self-time functions in a CPU profile (value[2] = cpu/nanoseconds), read from a file path.","sql":"SELECT frame[1].function AS fn, sum(value[2]) AS cpu_ns FROM pprof.main.stacks('data/go_cpu.pb.gz') WHERE error IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20;"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name":"sample_id","type":"BIGINT","description":"1-based index of the sample within its profile; joins to pprof.samples.sample_id."},{"name":"value","type":"BIGINT[]","description":"The sample's measured values, one BIGINT per meta.sample_types entry, in that order (e.g. value[2] is cpu/nanoseconds for a Go CPU profile)."},{"name":"labels","type":"MAP(VARCHAR, VARCHAR)","description":"Sample labels; duplicate keys are de-duplicated (first wins)."},{"name":"frame","type":"STRUCT(function VARCHAR, filename VARCHAR, line BIGINT, address UBIGINT)[]","description":"The call stack, leaf first; inlined frames expanded, unsymbolized frames keep their address. frame[1] is the leaf (self) frame."},{"name":"file","type":"VARCHAR","description":"Source path the row came from (NULL when the profile was passed as inline BLOB bytes)."},{"name":"error","type":"VARCHAR","description":"NULL on success; otherwise this is an error row for a file that could not be read or decoded, with every data column NULL and the failure message here."}]
